media.NotAllowedError: Access to the camera and microphone was blocked. You can continue watching only, or allow the permission in your browser and refresh.
media.NotFoundError: No camera or microphone was found. You joined to watch and listen only.

media.OverconstrainedError: The camera does not support the required settings. You joined to watch only.
media.AbortError: Access to the camera was interrupted. You joined to watch only.
media.insecure: Video needs a secure connection (HTTPS). At the current address the browser blocks access to the camera.
media.fallback: The camera and microphone cannot be accessed. You joined to watch only.

recording.consentWhat: The recording will become a lesson in the archive, with a transcript and summary. It includes audio only, no video.

recording.unsupported: This browser does not support recording. Try Chrome, Edge or Firefox.
